settings.heading: Pregnancy runs a deficit. Feeding extends it.

settings.content: One woman on a forum put it better than most clinical summaries.
“You’ve had a lot of nutrients borrowed by your little one.”
Borrowed is the right word. Not lost. Moved — on the understanding it comes back.
Three things your skin leans on run down through pregnancy and feeding.

settings.aria_label: Three depleted stores and a fourth that is hidden
settings.legend: 1 The buffer in the vessel walls. 2 The barrier lipids — the ratio, not the amount. 3 The brake on inflammation. 4 — on no supplement label. It comes later.

settings.content: There’s a fourth. Weaning doesn’t return it, and it’s easier to explain once the first three are clear.
